hypotheses.justification: Derive hC from hlog t and hW t. By tensorNorm_nonneg, Real.one_le_exp, and Real.log_nonneg, log (exp 1 + tensorNorm 3 (U.velocity t)) is nonnegative. Thus R := 1 + ‖(U.velocity t).toLp‖ + W t * log (exp 1 + tensorNorm 3 (U.velocity t)) satisfies R ≥ 1 > 0. The lemma U.gradientNormPath_nonneg t and hlog t give 0 ≤ C * R, so nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left yields 0 ≤ C. The existing proof then works unchanged using this derived hC. This also covers T = 0 and zero velocity: the supplied t exists and R remains at least 1.
